install_steps: brew tap Polymarket/polymarket-cli https://github.com/Polymarket/polymarket-cli && brew install polymarket
note: Also available via: curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Polymarket/polymarket-cli/main/install.sh | sh. For trading, set POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY or run polymarket setup. Read-only commands (markets, events, prices) work without a wallet.
